title: ラウンドサイン
description: 丸いフレームと無地の看板。文字やロゴを追加できる案内用プロップ。 面順序を部品単位で修正した1.0.2候補。片面材質で表示し、開口を保持。
descriptionEn: A round frame and blank sign face, ready for your lettering or original logo. Version 1.0.2 candidate repairs component winding, uses single-sided materials and preserves the opening.
author: Xenoah

provenance.tool: Meshcopia original starter generator with component-specific winding repair 1; Blender 4.3.2 FBX conversion
provenance.rights: Original geometry/material formulas for Meshcopia. No third-party model, photograph, trademark, or scanned asset included.
provenance.changes: none. Version 1.0.2: The vertical torus was reflected by swapping Y/Z without reversing triangle order. Reverse only this torus; retain every coordinate and the central opening.

uv: Planar XZ per face; custom UV unwrap recommended for directional textures

usages.context: Created for the Meshcopia asset library; no external project usage recorded.
Component-specific correction of the original Meshcopia model; no third-party geometry.
